source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)

summary_en: A tenant insurance policy renews automatically on November 1, 2026 at $24.10 per month unless cancelled; coverage and contact details are listed.
text:
Northshore Insurance (fictional)
Policy renewal notice
Policy number: TN-000000
Your tenant insurance policy will renew automatically on November 1, 2026. Your new monthly premium is $24.10 (previously $22.90).
Coverage: contents up to $30,000; personal liability up to $1,000,000.
No action is needed to renew. To make changes or cancel, call 1-800-555-0150 before October 25, 2026.
